newsitem.title: UK: UK gilts close lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: UK gilts close lower on profit-taking.

text.p: 1625 GMT - UK gilt futures ended marginally lower on the day and well down on the contract high of 112-17 set during the session. Early gains on the back of European bond markets were later eroded by profit-taking.
* December long gilt contract ended 1/32 lower at 111-31
Cummings said volume was light, with rollovers accounting for much of the trade in futures. The market was waiting for Wednesday's auction of 2.5 billion stg 7.0 percent gilts due 2002.
"We've got the auction tomorrow and that will stall the market, I suspect," Cummings said. "The rest will depend on the rest of Europe."

Weak German industrial production data refuelled speculation about lower German rates. But the Bundesbank drew attention to recent comments from its president Hans Tietmeyer that he saw no short-term reason for a change in rates.
The gilt/bund spread at 10 years widened to 186 from Monday's close of 183.
March short sterling was down three basis points at 93.29, implying official interest rates around 6.70 percent compared with the present 6.0 percent.
